title: Affine restriction comparison is monic
statement: Under the hypotheses of the affine coimage-image comparison, the restriction of its level n component to an affine open is a monomorphism.

proof.text: The affine equivalence identifies the comparison with the module first-isomorphism map, which is injectivity; restriction and associated sheaf preserve this property, and universal kernel/cokernel identifications transport it.

lean.statement: theorem coherentFormalModules_coimageImage_isMono_restrict_affine (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) [HasKernels (CoherentFormalModule X I)] [HasCokernels (CoherentFormalModule X I)] (U : X.affineOpens) {F G : CoherentFormalModule X I} (α : F ⟶ G) (n : ℕ) : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U : X.Opens).ι).map ((Abelian.coimageImageComparison α).hom.app (op n)))
